svg.text: The Anti-hero's three forms: Regalia, Sovereign, Apex

The pieces each form adds, the aura colours (hue 260 to 320, a lighter tint of the same hue for the core, never white), the three beats of the transformation, and the check against the stacking rule. Working labels, pending Legal review.
A. The three forms, at rest (no aura) and charging or attacking (the thin outline and rings)
a high collar and two forearm guards
the collar and guards, a low faceted crest on the mask, and
three floating plates behind the shoulders
the guards fall away and the sound cuts out; the collar, the
crest and the plates stay, hanging still

B. The transformation beats (moveset-rules.md 10.8): he rises out of the crouch and goes still, one flick of the hand and the regalia locks on with a clack, then he settles and checks that the rival saw
The gather: rises, chin up, still, one hand palm-up. The aura is
pulled in to the sigil; no regalia yet
The break: one dismissive flick, the collar and guards lock on in this
frame, one thin ring leaves the body in his colour
The settle: composed, the new aura holds steady and thin, the line is
C. The colour values: the aura, the flashes and the power-stage glow for each form
info flash core (keyline is the shadow)
Deutan contrast of the aura rim against five backdrops (WCAG ratio; the keyline carries the rest, 3.0 reads):
sky horizon 3.1, sea 1.1, grass 1.3, dusk rock 1.1, night 4.5
sky horizon 2.6, sea 1.3, grass 1.1, dusk rock 1.3, night 5.4
sky horizon 3.8, sea 1.2, grass 1.6, dusk rock 1.1, night 3.6
The rim alone is mid-value (L* 46 to 56), so it does not separate from the dusk rock or the grass by value: the thin dark keyline (L* 14 to 18) and the two-tone edge do, as for the fighter's
body. The core is the lightest step and sits inside the outline. All three hues are inside Legal's 260 to 320 degrees; none is red, orange, gold, yellow or white, and none is a mid blue
D. The stacking rule (Legal): no single moment shows more than two of the seven marks
1. a crouch with fists clenched at the sides
2. a scream or a drawn-out chant
3. a flame-shaped body aura streaming upward
4. rubble rising in a ring, ground cracking and wind under a changing sky
7. a gold, white or red flash with a form name shouted
The transformation, new staging (gather, break, settle; this sheet)

The ground cracks at the break only when he stands on it (part of mark 4); there is no crouch (he rises), no scream, a violet thin outline, no lightning, his hair is fixed, the flash is violet and he speaks a line, not a form
ma-3 staging, moment 3 (the old surge pose, before this pass)

The pose was arms thrown wide with the head back, which 10.8 forbids (the snap is never that), and the blade crest rose over the head. Fixed in this pass: the surge now uses the settled, composed pose, and the crest is the low
wide crest. Marks present now: only the ground shards at the feet (part of mark 4).
marks present (by number above): none | pass
A small pulse of shapes up and back of the head in the lane colour: no flame, no flash of gold, white or red, no form name. At most one mark in any frame.
The aura (this sheet, and the HUD crown)
marks present (by number above): none | pass

A thin outline and rings in the lane colour, only while charging or attacking, never at rest, never upward streaming. It stands for no mark by itself; with a crouch and a scream it would be three, so the staging keeps the crouch
Damage sheet, the old Aura variant of round 3 (blank-variations.md)
The round-3 "Aura" variant (not chosen) drew a standing aura of tall slabs. It is not in use: Orb chose Marked plus flashes, which has no standing aura.
